content.value_statement: Agent frameworks often hide failure paths, weak isolation, and incomplete recovery behavior. This skill guides structured reviews of propagation, sandboxing, retries, fallbacks, and production readiness.
actual_capabilities: Maps how tool, parser, API, timeout, and state errors propagate through an agent loop.
Compares code execution isolation options such as no sandboxing, subprocesses, containers, and stronger runtimes.
Catalogs retry logic, fallback behavior, circuit breakers, and error feedback patterns.
Provides a Markdown output template for resilience findings and production readiness notes.
Connects resilience review results to related codebase mapping and antipattern analysis workflows.
limitations: It provides an analysis framework, not an automated scanner.
It depends on accurate codebase context from the user or another mapping skill.
It does not execute tests, verify runtime behavior, or enforce sandbox settings.
It focuses on agent framework resilience, not general application security coverage.

use_cases.title: Review Agent Failure Handling
use_cases.description: Trace how exceptions, timeouts, malformed output, and state failures move through an agent framework.

use_cases.title: Evaluate Code Execution Isolation
use_cases.description: Compare sandboxing controls, resource limits, and network restrictions before enabling generated code execution.

use_cases.title: Prepare Production Readiness Notes
use_cases.description: Summarize retry behavior, fallback coverage, critical gaps, and release risks in a consistent format.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Resilience Review
prompt_templates.scenario: Start with a small agent framework or focused module.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the resilience-analysis skill to review this agent code. Map error propagation, recovery behavior, and missing containment points.

prompt_templates.title: Sandbox Boundary Assessment
prompt_templates.scenario: Review code execution or tool execution paths.
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess the sandboxing model for this agent framework. Identify execution boundaries, filesystem access, network access, and resource limits.

prompt_templates.title: Retry And Fallback Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Evaluate reliability before a production release.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze retry, fallback, timeout, and circuit breaker behavior. Explain which failures recover and which failures still propagate.

prompt_templates.title: Production Risk Report
prompt_templates.scenario: Create a structured report for engineering leadership.
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a resilience report for this framework. Include propagation maps, sandbox assessment, recovery mechanisms, critical gaps, and readiness status.

output_examples.input: Review an agent framework that retries rate limits but lets state validation errors propagate.
output: Error propagation map showing recovered API rate limits and unrecovered state validation failures.
Sandboxing assessment covering code execution, filesystem scope, network access, and resource limits.
Risk assessment listing state recovery as a production readiness gap.

output_examples.input: Assess a generated-code tool that runs user code in a subprocess with timeout controls.
output: Isolation review comparing subprocess controls against container and microVM options.
Recovery notes for timeout handling, process termination, and tool feedback to the agent.
Recommended follow-up tests for memory limits, privilege dropping, and network restrictions.

best_practices: Start with a codebase map so execution paths and ownership boundaries are clear.
Separate observed behavior from recommended controls when writing the final report.
Validate critical recovery claims with tests, logs, or runtime traces when possible.
anti_patterns: Do not assume retry logic covers all API, parser, tool, and state failures.
Do not treat subprocess execution as strong isolation without resource and privilege controls.
Do not mark a framework production ready without checking failure propagation and containment.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes error propagation, sandboxing boundaries, retries, fallbacks, circuit breakers, and production readiness in agent frameworks.

faq.question: Does it run code or tests?
faq.answer: No. It provides a structured analysis workflow and report format. Users must run tests separately.

faq.question: Can it review code execution safety?
faq.answer: Yes. It helps compare sandbox options and identify missing isolation, resource limits, and network controls.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Use focused agent framework files, tool execution paths, retry code, sandbox code, and known failure scenarios.

faq.question: Is this only for security teams?
faq.answer: No. Platform engineers, technical leads, and reliability reviewers can use it for production readiness reviews.

faq.question: How should findings be verified?
faq.answer: Verify findings with tests, runtime traces, configuration review, and direct inspection of failure handling code.
